data.name: Sharwavin
data.gender_notes: Sharwavin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharwavin is derived from two Sanskrit words - Shara meaning 'victory' and Vin meaning 'god'. This name is believed to bring victory and success in all aspects of life. The name Sharwavin carries the meaning “God of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwavin usually hope their child will grow to embody god of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharwavin is a powerful and spiritual name that resonates with the energy of victory and success. It is believed to invoke the blessings of the gods and grant the bearer strength, courage, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Sharwavin belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwavin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
